own_solution.law: Energy conservation in inverse-square field: h = v^2 R / (2 g R - v^2)

defect_reasons.other: Minor wording issues: 'it' in TFA02/T9D2A follows the balloon sentence (D either way), 'before the firing ... speed given to the probe' in T04BD is slightly odd, and a weather balloon on an airless moon is unnatural; none changes any answer.

notes: Verified all certified answers: v=1500 -> 1157.01 km; 1560 -> 1323.35 km; 1710 -> 1878.54 km; 1830 -> 2552.47 km; all below escape speed sqrt(2gR) = 2372 m/s, so a turning point exists. Mass cancels in the energy relation. Minimal pairs TAA9D/T04BD (balloon vs probe, 210 m/s) and TFA02/T9791 (earlier vs this firing, 210 m/s) hold; numeral-free twins match. Agrees with pass 1.
